description: This Java class 'JsonKeyValidator' provides static utility functions for validating JSON object keys and JSON pointer keys to ensure they comply with specific constraints (no control characters, no slashes). It supports recursive validation of nested JSON objects and validates individual keys with external validator instances.

classes.name: JsonKeyValidator
classes.description: Utility class for validating JSON object keys and JSON pointer keys according to specific rules.

methods.name: validateJsonKeys
methods.description: Validates all keys within a JsonObject, recursively validating nested objects. Throws exception if any key is invalid.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates each key within a JsonPointer, throwing exception if any key is invalid.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Private helper method that validates a single JsonKey, throwing exception if invalid.
